claims.text: The dataset was created based on hotel reviews from TripAdvisor, containing approximately 50 million reviews.
HotelRec is the largest publicly available dataset in the hotel domain, significantly larger than previous datasets.
The dataset includes user profiles, hotel URLs, overall ratings, summaries, user-written text, dates, and sub-ratings.
